red_flag.title: Please get medical help now
red_flag.body: What you described can be a sign of a serious problem. HappyGut won't give food advice right now. Contact your doctor straight away, or go to the nearest emergency department or call 999 if you feel very unwell.
red_flag.category.possible_obstruction: possible blocked bowel (vomiting or pain with no stool or gas)
not_food: We couldn't see any food in this photo. Please take a photo of the food or drink, or type what you ate.
no_items: We couldn't tell what food this is. Please type the dish name or take a clearer photo.
clarify.default: Could you tell us the name of this dish?
template.hard_rule: Because of the narrowing (stricture) in your bowel, foods with {components} are best avoided.
template.guideline: {name} contains {components}, which IBD guidance says can bother the gut.
template.personal: Your own diary shows {components} has often been followed by symptoms for you.
template.no_risk: {name} has no components that the guidance we hold flags for you.
template.low_confidence: We aren't sure enough about {name} to judge it.
template.unresolved: We don't know "{name}" yet, so we can't judge it.
template.summary: Tap each dish to see the evidence behind it.
unreviewed_knowledge: Development build: based on knowledge that hasn't been reviewed yet.
